report.title: Open‑Source LLM Releases – Week of 2026‑09‑17 to 2026‑09‑23
report.executive_summary: During the week ending 23 September 2026, the only confirmed open‑source large language model (LLM) release was Nokia’s AnyJev layer, announced on 17 September. No other new models were reported in the available evidence. The release adds a training‑free calibration layer that can be applied to existing open‑source LLMs.

findings.title: Nokia Announces AnyJev – A Training‑Free Calibration Layer
findings.summary: Nokia released AnyJev, a layer that can be added to any open‑source LLM to transform it into a calibrated decision‑making model without additional training. The announcement came on 17 September 2026 and highlights the layer’s ability to improve decision quality across a range of tasks.
findings.why_it_matters: It provides a practical tool for developers to enhance the reliability of open‑source LLMs without the cost of retraining, potentially accelerating adoption in enterprise settings.
